g.text: STUDENT ATTENDANCE MONITORING SYSTEM USING FACIAL RECOGNITION
San Roque National High School (SRNHS) — System Architecture Design

svg.text: • Local SQLite Buffer for Offline Failover
• Photo Storage & Embedding sync to Supabase
• Instant event push on attendance_logs INSERT
• Encrypted HTTPS URLs with token-based access
• Carrier Transmission to Smart, Globe, DITO
"SRNHS Alert: Student Juan Dela Cruz has
• Cross-platform access via modern Web Browsers

g.text: Hardware & Computer Vision Engine
• Camera: USB 1080p HD Optical Webcam / RTSP IP Cam
• Vision Framework: Python 3.10+ / OpenCV 4.x / DeepFace
• Feature Model: FaceNet 128D Embeddings / Cosine Match
• Benchmark: < 1.2s inference response time per face
Web Frontend & Security
• Architecture: Single Page Application (React 19 + Vite)
• Styling & UI: Tailwind CSS, Lucide Icons, Framer Motion
• Data Security: Row-Level Security (RLS) & JWT Bearer
• Legal: Compliant with RA 10173 (Data Privacy Act 2012)
Cloud BaaS & Database
• Database: PostgreSQL Relational DB (Supabase Hosted)
• Real-time Sync: WebSockets (CDC on attendance_logs)
• Storage: Supabase Secure Storage Bucket ('student-faces')
• Reliability: Automatic connection retry & local buffer
SMS Notification Gateway
• Provider: PhilSMS / Semaphore / Twilio Cloud API
• Protocol: REST JSON over TLS 1.3
• Coverage: Nationwide GSM (Smart, TNT, Globe, TM, Dito)
• Latency: Guaranteed < 5 seconds guardian notification
